title: Capital Gains: Forfeiture of Advance Money & Sec 54 Exemption
subject: DT
provision_raw: Section 54 & Section 51: Capital Gains Exemption & Forfeiture of Advance Money. Section 51: Advance money forfeited prior to 01/04/2014 reduced from Cost of Acquisition. Section 56(2)(ix): Advance money forfeited on or after 01/04/2014 taxed under Income from Other Sources, does not reduce COA. Section 54: Reinvestment in residential house.
story_summary: Vikram purchased a property in Kochi for ₹30 Lakhs. He forfeited an advance of ₹5 Lakhs in 2012 (pre-2014) and ₹8 Lakhs in 2018 (post-2014), before finally selling the property for ₹1 Crore in 2023 and reinvesting in a residential house.

slides.scene_purpose: Demonstrate the receipt and forfeiture of advance money prior to 01/04/2014 under Section 51.
slides.dialogue_manglish: First sceneil, 2012-il Vikram thante commercial plot Mr. A-kku sell cheyyaan agreement undaakki. Mr. A 5 Lakhs advance aayi nalki, pakshe transaction complete cheyyaan pattiyilla. So Vikram 5 Lakhs forfeit cheythu. Since this forfeiture happened prior to 1st April 2014, Section 51 prakaaram Cost of Acquisition-il ninnu ithu reduce cheyyanam.

slots.title: 2012: Advance Forfeited (Pre-01/04/2014)
slots.note: Advance forfeited prior to 01/04/2014 reduces Cost of Acquisition.

slides.scene_purpose: Show the reduction of original Cost of Acquisition due to pre-2014 forfeiture.
slides.dialogue_manglish: Ivide Vikram-inte original Cost of Acquisition 30 Lakhs aayirunnu. Section 51 prakaaram pre-2014 forfeit cheytha 5 Lakhs deduct cheyyumpol, adjusted Cost of Acquisition 25 Lakhs aayi maarum.

slots.title: Impact of Sec 51 on Cost of Acquisition
slots.note: Original COA ₹30L - Pre-2014 Advance ₹5L = Adjusted COA ₹25L.

slides.scene_purpose: Demonstrate forfeiture of advance money on/after 01/04/2014 governed by Section 56(2)(ix).
slides.dialogue_manglish: Next, 2018-il Mr. B aayittu undaakkiya agreement-il Vikram 8 Lakhs advance vaangukayum forfeit cheyyukayum cheythu. But remember, 1st April 2014-nu sesham nadakkunna forfeiture Section 56(2)(ix) prakaaram Income from Other Sources aayi full tax cheyyappedum. Cost of Acquisition-il oru reduction-um varilla!

slots.title: 2018: Advance Forfeited (Post-01/04/2014)
slots.note: Taxable under IFOS in the year of forfeiture. COA remains unchanged!

slides.slide_title: Comparative Tax Matrix: Sec 51 vs Sec 56(2)(ix)
slides.scene_purpose: Summarize the statutory distinction based on the cutoff date of 1st April 2014.
slides.dialogue_manglish: Exam point of view-il ee cutoff date valare crucial aanu. Cutoff line: 1st April 2014! Ithinu munpullaa forfeiture Cost of Acquisition-il ninnu reduce cheyyanam. 1st April 2014-lo athinu seshamo ulla forfeiture Income from Other Sources-il tax cheyyum, Cost of Acquisition-il no change!

slots.title: Statutory Comparison Matrix
slots.note: Crucial distinction: Post-2014 advance is taxed upfront as revenue income.

slides.scene_purpose: Calculate the final Capital Gain when property is sold in 2023.
slides.dialogue_manglish: 2023-il Vikram ee property 1 Crore-nu vittu. Capital Gain calculate cheyyumpol Sale Consideration 1 Crore-il ninnu Adjusted Cost of Acquisition 25 Lakhs maathram subtract cheyyuka. 2018-le 8 Lakhs already Income from Other Sources-il tax aayathukondu COA 25 Lakhs thanne aayirikkum. Total Capital Gain: 75 Lakhs!

slots.title: Capital Gain Computation (2023)
slots.note: Post-2014 advance of ₹8L did not alter the COA of ₹25L.

slides.scene_purpose: Verify if the reinvestment in a residential house satisfies Section 54 timeline criteria.
slides.dialogue_manglish: Ini final step! Vikram 75 Lakhs Capital Gain labhicha sesham 1 year-inullil puthiyoru Residential House purchase cheythu. Section 54 prakaaram sale date muthal 2 years-inullil new house purchase cheythaal full Capital Gain Exemption eligible aanu!

slots.title: Sec 54 Reinvestment Window
slots.note: Reinvestment made within statutory 2-year window. Full Sec 54 exemption granted!
